<!--
  The simple FAQ (model faq@1): the heading, a description and the questions as a list, each with its answer.
  Axes: columns (one, two from md up).
-->
<script lang="ts" module>
  import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
  import type { SimpleQuestion } from "./faq-simple.types";

  export type FaqSimpleProps = {
    id: string;
    title: string;
    description?: string;
    items: SimpleQuestion[];
    level?: 1 | 2 | 3;
    padding?: "compact" | "standard" | "spacious";
    align?: "start" | "center" | "end";
    columns?: "one" | "two";
    landmarkLabel?: string;
  };
</script>

<script lang="ts">
  import Block from "../compose/Block.svelte";
  import Container from "../compose/Container.svelte";
  import List from "../compose/List.svelte";
  import ListItem from "../compose/ListItem.svelte";
  import Stack from "../compose/Stack.svelte";
  import Text from "../compose/Text.svelte";
  import Title from "../compose/Title.svelte";
  import { cn } from "../utils";

  let {
    id,
    title,
    description = "",
    items,
    level = 2,
    padding = "standard",
    align = "start",
    columns = "two",
    landmarkLabel,
  }: FaqSimpleProps = $props();
  const titleId = $derived(id + "-title");
  const column = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "end"
    : "start"
  );
  const textAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "text-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "text-end"
    : "text-start"
  );
  const itemsAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "items-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "items-end"
    : "items-start"
  );
  const selfAlign = $derived(
    (align as string) === "center" ? "self-center"
    : (align as string) === "end" ? "self-end"
    : ""
  );
  const grid = $derived(((columns as string) === "two") ? "md:grid-cols-2" : "");
  const narrow = $derived(((columns as string) === "one") ? "mx-auto w-full max-w-3xl" : "");
</script>

<Block
  tag="section"
  class={
    (padding as string) === "compact" ? "py-8 lg:py-16"
    : (padding as string) === "spacious" ? "py-24 lg:py-40"
    : "py-16 lg:py-32"
  }
  aria-labelledby={(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)}
  aria-label={landmarkLabel}
  data-slot="faq-simple"
>
  <Container class="mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4">
    <Stack gap="12" align="stretch" class={narrow}>
      <Stack gap="4" align={column} class={cn("max-w-2xl", selfAlign)}>
        <Title as={level} size="3xl" weight="bold" class={cn("tracking-tight", textAlign)} id={titleId}>
          {title}
        </Title>
        {#if description}
          <Text size="base" class={cn("text-muted-foreground", textAlign)}>
            {description}
          </Text>
        {/if}
      </Stack>
      <List tag="ul" class={cn("m-0 w-full list-none p-0", cn("grid grid-cols-1 gap-8", grid))}>
        {#each items as f (f.id)}
          <ListItem class="flex flex-col gap-2" data-slot="question">
            <Title as={(level + 1)} size="lg" weight="semibold" class="text-start">
              {f.title}
            </Title>
            <Text size="base" class="text-muted-foreground text-start">
              {f.description}
            </Text>
          </ListItem>
        {/each}
      </List>
    </Stack>
  </Container>
</Block>
